title: Learning stochastic dynamics from snapshots through regularized unbalanced optimal transport
tldr_zh: DeepRUOT 用 Fisher 正则把 RUOT 的 SDE 约束化成 ODE，无先验同时学增殖率与转移动力学，消除假转移并重建 Waddington 景观
tldr_en: DeepRUOT solves regularized unbalanced OT via Fisher regularization, turning SDE constraints into ODEs to jointly learn growth and transport from snapshots
